answer.rationale: Do not respond with broad discounting: the recovered pricing test increased qualified revenue 18% but reduced 30-day retention 12%, indicating poor sustainable value despite short-term acquisition gains. Shortening onboarding is confirmed to improve completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, while signup simplification also improved SMB activation. Run a guarded test focused on price-sensitive SMB accounts, monitor qualified revenue, activation, renewal intent, and retention, and avoid assuming onboarding alone will fully offset competitor pricing pressure.
